title: lavanito/python-rag-textbook
summary: 该项目提供了一个关于检索增强生成（RAG）的Python代码示例，基于国家账户手册和GDP统计数据语料库。代码可读性强，经过测试，非生产代码。使用开源工具Ollama、Qwen3、sentence-transformers、bm25s和Chroma在本地运行。，采用模块化架构，关注性能和算法优化
description: Annotated Python code for a textbook on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), built on national accounts manuals and a GDP-statistics corpus. Readable, tested, not production code. Runs locally with open-source tools: Ollama, Qwen3, sentence-transformers, bm25s and Chroma.
